title: zygia coccinea
intro: Zygia coccinea, commonly known as the Scarlet Pea Tree or Coral Tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. It is native to Central and South America, and its flowers are known for their vibrant red and white colors. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Zygia coccinea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects.
